nodes.title: Open and switch independent project tabs

body:
## Parent

[#37 — Spec: One-window IDE with project tabs and shared Agents](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/37)

## What to build

Project-created chats inherit their exact home; Agents offers an explicit home or intentional No Workspace. Deliberate workspace changes update the existing chat's home; incidental file access does not.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Persist one explicit home per project-associated chat through a provider-neutral contract, distinguishing unresolved metadata, intentional No Workspace and a recorded home.
- [x] Represent exact folder or saved workspace-file identity together with environment; different worktrees and local/SSH/Dev Container authorities remain distinct.
- [ ] Chats created in a project inherit its home. Agents creation offers an explicit home or a workspace-less quick chat without inferring ownership from the last visited project.
- [ ] A deliberate working-workspace change moves the existing chat's home; incidental file access, repository similarity, folder containment and other chats in the session do not.
- [x] Reuse existing provider/persistence ownership without another transcript store. Shared contracts live in Workbench or lower layers; Sessions adapters compose above them and provider implementations stay out of shared consumers.
- [x] Cover project and Agents creation, workspace-less state, reassignment, overlapping workspaces and mixed-home sessions with observable ownership/persistence tests.

## Execution boundary

This is an approved implementation slice within [#34](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/34). Inspect and reuse its published disposable baseline; implement only missing behaviour using existing services and test infrastructure. Preserve the full accepted contract in #37 and its authoritative linked resolutions, including requirements not repeated here.

Use a named bounded scenario, isolated app-owned state and scratch workspaces. Record exact source/build, focused checks, failures/repairs and unperformed coverage. [#35](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/35) retains the full staged runtime acceptance gate and separate creator verdict. Provider work/sign-in remains deferred and authorization probes remain paused. Publication does not start execution, lift those limits, establish feasibility or authorize a production merge.

comments.body:
Partial implementation checkpoint — leave this issue open.

Agent Host exact per-chat durable homes and deliberate reassignment are integrated (`80315b75855`, `8c87c898a59`, merge `8277cf17bf3`). Existing catalog ownership is reused; null/unresolved/exact home and environment remain distinct. Service/provider/catalog/persistence suites, client build/typecheck/lint/layer checks passed; exact groups and sources are in the handoff. This is deterministic service evidence, not real-provider runtime.

Unchecked criteria1,3–4 remain partial: extension-backed owners (including Copilot Cloud) have no durable home creation/assignment hooks and must fail explicitly; no app-local fallback was added. Project-side chat presentation still needs #52 persistent Agents broker. Review recorded a protocol metadata reader in the wrong prescribed boundary (P2). Real desktop/remote/provider validation and #35 are unperformed.

Open native blockers: #39. Checked criteria describe only established source/service or explicitly recorded runtime behavior; unchecked compound criteria remain incomplete. A merge or unit pass is not full runtime acceptance.

Checkpoint source `403375db5f1794d95849d795ceecbf8553d2dfdb`; integration branch `integration/spec-37-complete`; draft [PR #60](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/pull/60). [Committed handoffs, evidence and review](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/blob/d71ae1f23b018cfc7f99616d24f187dc96375ea6/prototypes/live-hosting/spec-37/checkpoint-2026-10-28/README.md). Orchestration is stopped; no worker remains assigned. Provider work/sign-in stays deferred, authorization probes stay paused, no production merge is authorized, and #35 retains full staged acceptance plus the separate creator verdict.
